title: Custom web applications
summary: Dashboards, portals and internal tools built around how your team already works.
description: When spreadsheets and off-the-shelf software no longer fit, we build a web application around your actual workflow: who enters what, who approves it and which reports you need at the end of the day. It runs in the browser, so your team can use it from the office, from home or on a phone.
included: Workshops to map your process and agree on a written scope
Screen designs you review before development starts
User roles and permissions, so each person sees only what they need
Reports and exports to Excel or PDF
Bangla and English interface where you need it
Training for your team and handover documents
